paragraph_text_presence.meaning: Three reviewed prose spans on page 54; not paragraph segmentation or mathematical fidelity.

question_numbering.meaning: Expected numbers 1–10 on page 351. Extra detections recorded separately.

subquestion_marker_recall.meaning: Markers under exercise 2.2 question 1, page 57. Does not certify complete diagram-to-subpart association.

answer_option_completeness.meaning: No independently annotated MCQ in this diagnostic sample; not measured.

page_reference_accuracy.meaning: Physical PDF page references of the ten sampled questions.

question_reading_order.meaning: Question-number sequence on page 351, not full-book visual reading order.

answer_candidate_mapping.meaning: Unique number-based candidate mappings to ten source answer entries; duplicates fail the check. All mappings remain unverified and unusable for automatic grading.

releaseGate: NOT READY for unattended educational publication. Sample metrics do not establish full-book accuracy.
limitations: Selected diagnostic pages, not a randomized or exhaustive gold corpus.
Raw source preservation is not semantic extraction accuracy.
Mathematics, table cells, graphical subparts and whole-book reading order still require independent annotation.
